title: tx_queue_stats_get doc/impl mismatch on locking
description:
Header doc at lines 206-208 states 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation (tx_queue.c lines 416-430) performs raw struct assignment without acquiring the mutex. Concurrent writer causes data race.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 213
